test_pickle_dataset: test that a CompilerGym Dataset object can be serialized and deserialized with pickle
test_pickle_benchmark: test that a benchmark from a CompilerGym Dataset can be pickled and unpickled
test_pickle_cbench_dataset: test that the cbench-v1 dataset from LlvmEnv can be pickled and compared for equality
test_pickle_cbench_benchmark: test that a benchmark from the cbench-v1 dataset can be pickled and unpickled
run_datasets_pickle_test: run the pytest test suite for LLVM dataset pickle serialization using python -m
